items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: Hank was interviewed via Zoom on April 20, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Hank was interviewed via Zoom on April 20, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Hank Cicalo with me today. And I’m going to start out with a statement and see if you agree with it, Hank, and that is for 60-some years you’ve had one of the coolest jobs possible.
